_comment: Template: profile-driven validation. Every instance document under modelsDir is validated against the shapes of the profiles it declares (md:Model.profile, dcterms:conformsTo), found through the DX-PROF descriptors of a profile library. No mapping CSV, no list of constraint files.
_how_to_use: Copy this file to your working directory. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_PATH value with a real path. Check the plan first: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar validate --config this-file.json --dry-run. Then run without --dry-run.
_when_to_use: Use this for a repository or delivery of many instance files with declared profiles, such as ENTSO-E ReliCapGrid, where writing a mapping CSV would repeat what the files and the profile library already say.
_note_modelsDir: The folder of the instance documents (.xml, or .zip archives of them), searched at any depth. Each first-level subfolder is an area: its CGMES documents form the group cgmes-<area>, its network-codes datasets nc-<area>. Documents that declare no profile (reference data) are skipped and listed. Relative paths are relative to this config file.
_note_profilesLibrary: Folders holding DX-PROF descriptors and the SHACL files they name, for example a checkout of the ENTSO-E application-profiles-library with its submodules (git clone --recurse-submodules). Several folders may be given, for example one per release.
_note_boundaryFolders: Folders of boundary data, relative to modelsDir. Their documents are validated as the boundary group, with the boundary-only shapes, and loaded as context for every other group so references to the boundary resolve.
_note_outputDir: Where to write validation_report__<timestamp>.xlsx (one row per group and document, plus rows for documents that were not validated) and, with exportTurtle, one <group>__shacl_report.ttl per group. Created if it does not exist.
_note_datatypeMap: Bundled datatype map used when parsing the documents: 'CGMES30NC25', 'CGMES30NC24' or 'CGMES24NC22', or an absolute path to a .properties file. Without the right map, numeric and boolean constraints report wrongly.
_note_allowUnmapped: false (default): a document whose profile is not in the library, or lacks a shape file, stops the run with exit 2. true: such documents are skipped and the run is reported as incomplete (exit 1, never remapped by violationsExitCode).
_note_boundaryShapesPattern: Optional, default "EquipmentBoundary": shape files whose name contains it apply to boundary groups only. "" applies every shape everywhere.
_note_commonShapes: Optional, default: 61970-600-1_AllProfiles-AP-Con-Complex-SHACL.ttl where the library has it (no descriptor refers to it). A list of file names of the library or paths; ["none"] for none.
_note_profileNamespaces: Optional, default ["https://ap.cim4.eu/"]: dcterms:conformsTo values under these prefixes are profile declarations even when the library does not have them, so they are reported as unknown rather than ignored.
_note_groups: Optional, configuration files only: explicit groups replacing the grouping by folder, for example an assembled model that needs every area's EQ as context. [{"name": "cgm", "reported": ["Instance/CGM"], "context": ["Instance/AreaA/EQ.xml", "Instance/boundaryData"], "boundary": false, "extraShapes": [], "assumeProfiles": []}]. Paths are relative to this config file.
_note_sarifFile: Optional: "sarifFile": "REPLACE_WITH_PATH/output/cimpal.sarif" writes the findings as SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub code scanning. With it: "sarifBase" (the repository root, default the working directory), "sarifCategory" (default "cimpal-profiles"), "sarifMode" ('rule', default, or 'object').
_note_summaryMarkdown: Optional: "summaryMarkdown": "REPLACE_WITH_PATH/output/summary.md" writes a Markdown summary of the run (for $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY).
